profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, that describes itself as providing "Products & Solutions for AI Developers." According to its website, the company offers Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API for developers building with Meta's AI models and tools. The site highlights Muse Image, available on Meta Model API at $0.01/image, as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing. Meta also offers search grounding to give models live access to the web and describes its coding capabilities as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with performance competitive with frontier models across several coding evals.

Meta's primary tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family often self-hosted. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the year ending December 31, 2025, according to its 10-K filing. Meta is a public company founded in 2004 with ticker META and CIK 0001326801.

Meta faces three active lawsuits: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. The company has significant legal exposure in California, with 220 cases tracked in that jurisdiction. Meta operates seven MCP servers, including tools for Meta Ads automation and campaign management, LLM comparison and image generation, research corpus access, and desktop workspace control.
